In four-dimensional quantum field theories evaluated with dimensional regularization, every closed loop integral contributes a characteristic factor

  (1/16π²)  =  1/(4π)² .

Thus, if a diagram has L loops, its overall numerical factor contains

  (1/16π²)ᴸ  =  1/(4π)²ᴸ  =  1/(4π)^(2L).

The scratched note shows the factor 1/(4π)^6.  Setting

  2L  =  6   ⇒   L  =  3.

Therefore the original Feynman diagram must have contained three loops.

Answer: B
